_note: Hand-labelled ground truth, written before any prompt was run. dev = used to tune the engine and prompts. test = held out, run once. Unlisted axes default to 0.1.

dev.name: Wedding photographer
dev.text: I'm a wedding photographer, I shoot all day and back up raw files on the phone. Budget around 60k.

dev.name: Competitive gamer
dev.text: Competitive BGMI player. Long sessions, frame drops kill me.

dev.name: Basic user
dev.text: Just need something for WhatsApp and calls, doesn't have to be fancy, under 25000.

dev.name: Trek guide
dev.text: Trek guide in Ladakh, no signal for days, I drop my phone on rocks constantly.

dev.name: Heart patient
dev.text: My dad is 68 and has a heart condition. He wants to track his ECG, needs a big battery and a light phone.

dev.name: Music producer
dev.text: Music producer, I listen to reference mixes on the go and keep huge sample libraries.

dev.name: Travel vlogger
dev.text: Travel vlogger. I film 4K daily, edit on the phone, and fly a lot so I want it light. Battery matters less because I carry a power bank.

dev.name: Hinglish student
dev.text: camera bilkul nahi chahiye honestly, mostly coding notes aur YouTube, battery achhi ho, budget 30k

test.name: Street photographer
test.text: I'm a street photographer who mostly shoots at night. I don't game at all.

test.name: Field geologist
test.text: Field geologist. Rain, mud, no network on site, and I need to read air and heat sensors.

test.name: College student
test.text: College student, tight budget of 28,000. Netflix at night and some casual gaming.

test.name: Day trader
test.text: Day trader, constantly on 5G. Need the fastest data possible and a phone that never lags, 80k is fine.

test.name: Marathon runner
test.text: Marathon runner, I want it as light as possible and I want to monitor my heart rate and oxygen.

test.name: Audiophile
test.text: Audiophile with a 1TB FLAC collection. Nothing else matters.

test.name: Site supervisor
test.text: Construction site supervisor. My phone gets dropped weekly, it's covered in dust, and it has to last a 12-hour shift.

test.name: Streamer
test.text: Mobile Genshin player who also streams gameplay on 5G. Money's no issue.

test.name: Wildlife photographer
test.text: Wildlife photographer, long zoom is everything. I spend weeks in forests with no coverage.

test.name: Light user
test.text: I barely use my phone except for maps and calls when I travel. Keep it cheap and small. Max 22k.

test.name: Night nurse
test.text: Nurse on night shifts. The battery must survive 14 hours, and I'd also like to check my own vitals.

test.name: Content creator
test.text: Content creator doing YouTube shorts and podcasts. Needs a good camera, good audio, plenty of storage. ₹70,000.

test.name: Grandmother
test.text: My grandmother wants a phone she can't easily break, with loud sound, that lasts days on a charge.

test.name: Frequent flyer
test.text: Frequent flyer consultant. Lightest phone possible that's still fast. Don't care about the camera.

test.name: Hinglish gamer
test.text: Mujhe sirf gaming chahiye, BGMI aur COD, budget 50 hazaar, aur phone garam nahi hona chahiye.

test.name: Traveller
test.text: Photographer and traveller with a ₹1,00,000 budget. I want everything to be good but camera first, then battery.
